text: ユキさんに　いい　けいけんを　させて　あげられました　ありがとう！

structure.jp: させて　あげられました
structure.en: I was able to let her have

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる is する changed to mean 'let someone do' or 'make someone do'. けいけんを　させて = 'letting her have an experience'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: させて　あげられました
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form says the action is done as a favor for someone else. させて　あげられました = 'I was able to let her have it, for her sake'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: The られる ending here turns 'give' into 'can give'. あげられました = 'was able to give'.
